parts.note_add: Catalogue R 8871-28-160, L 8871-28-170 (S-005 2800A-1). Energy Suspension urethane Watt link bushing kit 11.7102G (40.36 USD at Atkins) re-bushes both links; each link goes in with its painted mark to the front and outside (S-002 13-15).
Genuine Mazda 8871-28-180 still sold new (Atkins, 139 USD, in stock); the seller notes it bends when the car hits a kerb and pairs it with link nuts B037-28-091.
Rebuilding a strut needs the spring compressor 49 0223 640B with 49 0370 641 and the pilot 49 0259 590 for the cap nut seal (S-002 13-5, 13-7).
Catalogue DAMPER, SUB SET-FRONT FA01-49-790 (S-005 3400A-1); Mazdatrix sells the OEM successor FA24-49-790 (137.78 USD) and KYB cartridge 363010 (70.41 USD) for 81-85 non-GSL-SE cars.

The partly illegible catalogue row is D-code 34760S, part 8171-34-970, qty 2, with O-ring 8171-34-731 (S-005 3400A-1); the drawing boxes it with the cap nut and seal of the oil-filled strut, so it reads as the seal/cap set. check against the parts counter.

Right F001-34-011A and left FA01-34-011A (S-005 3400A-1) have different free lengths, 325 and 334.5 mm (S-038 T:7). Racing Beat 14080 is a drop-in stiffer, 1 in lower set if stock springs are not found.

Mount FA01-34-390A is still sold new (Atkins 108 USD, Mazdatrix 128.85 USD). The thrust bearing gets a thin coat of rubber grease on both sides and the block goes back with its triangle mark where it was (S-002 13-8).
FA01-34-015 is sold new by Mazdatrix as a strut boot (38.16 USD) and by Atkins as a front bump stop (33 USD); the catalogue calls it COVER, DUST.
Bound bumper 8871-34-111A is no longer available from Mazda (Atkins lists it NLA).
Removal of the knuckle arm needs puller 49 0727 575 and the tie-rod end puller 49 0118 850C (S-002 13-9).
Rear springs 8871-28-011B (S-005 2800A-1) go in with the painted mark toward the axle casing (S-002 13-14).
Current service part 8871-28-013C (Atkins 23.50 USD, in stock) replaces 8871-28-013, -013A and -013B.
Catalogue damper set FA01-99-281A (S-005 2800A-1). Mazdatrix sells OEM FA24-28-700 (144.97 USD) and KYB 343140 (54.65 USD); Atkins sells KYB 343140 as its 8871-99-281 replacement (65 USD).
Bushing 8871-28-775 x4 (S-005 2800A-1); retainer 0223-28-776 still sold (Atkins 5.25 USD).
Catalogue LINK 8871-28-200 x2 (S-005 2800A-1). Energy Suspension 11.3104G (94 USD) re-bushes all four upper and lower links.
Lower link 8871-28-300A still sold new (Atkins 187 USD, in stock).
The 1985 manual treats the rear bar as optional ('if equipped', S-002 13-16); the 1981-83 catalogue lists one 18 mm bar 8871-28-151A for '81 and '82 models.
The catalogue gives 8871-28-156 for the 18 mm bar (S-005 2810A-1) but Mazdatrix lists 8871-28-156 as 17 mm and discontinued; measure the bar before ordering bushings.
Catalogue FA01-28-120B from serial FB331 510973 (S-005 2810A-1).
Bushing 0710-28-775 is still sold (Atkins 4.50 USD, Mazdatrix 5.15 USD; eight per car); Energy Suspension end-link set 9.8123 is the urethane alternative.

specs.item: Front coil spring constant
specs.note: About 121 lb/in. Same table in the 1981 and 1983 Technical Data.

specs.item: Front coil spring free length, standard, left
specs.note: 13.17 in. Left and right springs differ (catalogue R F001-34-011A, L FA01-34-011A, S-005 3400A-1). The 1985 manual gives 327 mm for its left spring (S-002 13-3); the 1982 figure governs this car.

specs.item: Front coil spring free length, standard, right
specs.note: 12.80 in; the 1985 manual gives the same 325 mm (S-002 13-3).

specs.item: Front coil spring number of coils
specs.note: 1985 specification table; no 1982 source gives a coil count.

specs.item: Front coil spring coil diameters
specs.note: 1985 table lists both diameters (the spring tapers); the existing PT056 row records only 123 mm.

specs.item: Replacement Racing Beat 14080 spring set: front spring rate
specs.note: Maker states 20% over stock and 1 in lower; describes the replacement, not the factory spring.

specs.item: Front shock absorber fluid capacity
specs.note: 0.23 +0.05 US qt. Applies to the rebuildable (non-cartridge) strut; the 1985 manual gives the same 225 cc (13.7 cu in) (S-002 13-7).

specs.item: Front shock absorber seal cap nut, tightening torque
specs.note: 36-43 ft-lb. For the original oil-filled strut; tighten with the piston rod fully lowered (S-002 13-7). Cap nut and oil seal are replaced with new ones on reassembly (S-002 13-7).

specs.item: Cap nut spanner size
specs.note: 2.05 in spanner or monkey wrench removes the cap nut and seal from the reservoir tube (1985 procedure).

specs.item: Front shock absorber type
specs.note: 1985 specification table.

specs.item: Cartridge-type damper cap nut, tightening torque
specs.note: 58-108 ft-lb; when a cartridge damper is fitted the oil-fill steps are skipped (1985 manual). No 1982 source gives this figure.

specs.item: Replacement KYB 363010 (Excel-G cartridge, 1981-85 RX-7 front): extended length
specs.note: 22.01 in as listed.

specs.item: Replacement KYB 363010: compressed length
specs.note: 15 in as listed; the same page lists stroke 14.09 in, which does not match extended minus compressed, so it is not recorded.

specs.item: Replacement KYB 363010: upper thread
specs.note: Listed as upper mount type 14x1.50; nitrogen gas-charged twin-tube, no internal rebound spring.

specs.item: Piston rod to mounting block, tightening torque
specs.note: 47-59 ft-lb; same in the 1985 manual (S-002 13-8).

specs.item: Mounting block to suspension tower, tightening torque
specs.note: 17-22 ft-lb; not in the 1982 Technical Data. Refit the block with its triangle mark in its original position; a replaced block needs a wheel alignment (1985 manual).

specs.item: Headlamp height difference, left to right, maximum
specs.note: 0.59 in, measured from level ground after fitting the struts; corrected with adjusting plates between mounting block and tower, no more than two per side (1985 manual).

specs.item: Replacement Mazda FA01-34-390A (current service mount): bearing inside diameter
specs.note: Seller figure; supersedes FA01-34-390 per the listing. check against the fitted mount.

specs.item: Adjusting plate thickness
specs.note: Seller says 2-3 can stack per side before the strut-top threads run out; the 1985 manual allows no more than two.

specs.item: Knuckle arm to shock absorber, tightening torque
specs.note: 46-69 ft-lb. The 1985 manual gives 95-119 N-m (S-002 13-8) for its own car; the 1982 figure governs this car.

specs.item: Rear coil spring constant (1982 figure)
specs.note: About 101 lb/in; the 1982 Technical Data gives the same figure as the 1980 row already recorded.

specs.item: Rear coil spring free length, standard (1982 figure)
specs.note: 12.74 in; same as the 1980 and 1985 figures.

specs.item: Rear coil spring wire diameter
specs.note: 0.39 in; 1985 table.

specs.item: Rear coil spring coil diameter
specs.note: 4.13 in; 1985 table.

specs.item: Rear coil spring number of coils
specs.note: 1985 table.

specs.item: Replacement Racing Beat 14080 spring set: rear spring rate
specs.note: Maker states 20% over stock and 1 in lower; describes the replacement.

specs.item: Rear shock absorber to axle housing, tightening torque
specs.note: 47-59 ft-lb; tighten with the car on its wheels (S-002 13-14). On the left side the lower bolt goes in head inboard (S-002 13-13).

specs.item: Rear shock absorber upper nut, tightening torque
specs.note: 9-18 ft-lb.

specs.item: Rear shock upper stud protrusion above nut
specs.note: 0.323 in, the 1985 figure for setting the upper nut on the bushings.

specs.item: Replacement KYB 343140 (Excel-G rear): extended length
specs.note: 20.75 in as listed.

specs.item: Replacement KYB 343140: compressed length
specs.note: 13.39 in as listed.

specs.item: Replacement KYB 343140: stroke
specs.note: 7.36 in as listed; upper mount type S1 (stud), lower E2 eye 12x32 mm.

specs.item: Upper link to axle housing, tightening torque
specs.note: 56-76 ft-lb; tighten with the car lowered on its wheels (S-002 13-17). The rear-end bolt goes in head inboard.

specs.item: Upper link to frame, tightening torque
Lower link to axle housing, tightening torque
specs.note: 56-76 ft-lb; tighten with the car lowered on its wheels (S-002 13-17).

specs.item: Lower link to frame, tightening torque
Watt link bracket (to axle housing), tightening torque
specs.note: 56-76 ft-lb; same in the 1985 manual (S-002 13-15).

specs.item: Watt link to axle housing, tightening torque
Watt link to bracket, tightening torque
specs.note: 47-59 ft-lb; 1985 gives the same for both link ends (S-002 13-15). Fit each link with its painted mark to the front and outside; tighten with the car on its wheels.

specs.item: Rear stabilizer bar diameter
specs.note: 0.71 in; 8871-28-151A for '81 & '82 models (16 mm bar to Oct 1980, 15 mm for '83). check by measuring the bar.

specs.item: Rear stabilizer support plate, tightening torque
specs.note: 23-34 ft-lb; final-tighten with the car on its wheels (S-002 13-17).

specs.item: Rear stabilizer lock nut (control link), tightening torque
specs.note: 7-12 ft-lb.

specs.item: Control link bolt protrusion below nut
specs.note: 0.169 in, the 1985 figure for setting the end-link nut on the bushings.

specs.item: Stabilizer mounting bracket to body frame, tightening torque
specs.note: 27-38 ft-lb; not in the 1982 Technical Data.

specs.item: Rear stabilizer bushing orientation
specs.note: 1985 procedure; the front bar's bushing faces front (S-002 13-12).
